title: Kissed with Caraway Chinese Rice Noodles Lo Mein
description: A chewy and resinous Jiangsu-inspired Lo Mein dish featuring caraway seeds and bonito shavings, suitable for Buddhist temple-friendly meals.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the sliced bok choy stems and stir-fry until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the bok choy leaves and stir-fry until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the bamboo rice noodles and stir-fry for about 2 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the caraway seeds, bonito flakes, sesame oil, soy sauce, and salt. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, until the noodles are well coated.
Transfer the lo mein to a serving platter and garnish with additional caraway seeds and bonito flakes, if desired.
